purpose: Prevent support/contact regression while retaining structured proximity and vertical reranking.

development_policy.selected_route: family_slot_rerank only if support/contact selection and source family composition are exact at every K, K=100 paired delta-Recall lower CI >= -0.01, and paired delta-Violation upper CI < 0

routing.support_passthrough_product: use source score for support/contact and structured product otherwise
routing.family_slot_rerank: preserve the source-ranked sequence of predicate-family slots; retain source order inside support/contact slots and use structured-product order inside proximity and vertical slots

claim_boundary: Retrospective 3DSSG method development. A passing route supports family-selective applicability, not dataset-level generalization or support/contact physical understanding.
